idea-plugin.name: Agent Ready Website Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Run an SEO and AI search audit of any web page without leaving the IDE: see it the way Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI agents read it. No account or API key needed.

Open Tools | Agent Ready Website Audit and choose:

  • SEO Audit of a Page: indexing, title and meta description, headings, schema markup (JSON-LD), links, image alt text and AI readiness, with each problem and its evidence.
  • Check AI Crawler Access: whether GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more may read a page, from robots.txt, meta tags and headers.
  • Check robots.txt, Sitemaps and llms.txt: plus the agent files under /.well-known.

The summary appears as a notification with Open Report, a shareable report page kept for 30 days, and Show Details, which opens the full result as JSON in an editor tab.

The checks run on the hosted Agent Ready Website Audit server at mcp.workpods.ai, which fetches only the public page you enter. It records the domain and path it checked, never the query string, your IP address or the page text. Read the privacy policy. It never signs in, submits forms or changes a site.
